title: Discuss your performance review (B2)
summary: Tóm tắt thành tích bằng kết quả đo được, nhận phản hồi về điểm cần cải thiện và đặt mục tiêu tiếp theo trong buổi đánh giá.
learningObjectives: Tóm tắt thành tích bằng kết quả đo được
Đón nhận điểm cần cải thiện một cách chuyên nghiệp
Đề xuất mục tiêu và hỗ trợ cần có cho kỳ tới

vocabulary.example: My objective is to lead one design review each month.

performanceTask.title: Present your review summary
performanceTask.scenario: In a half-year review, your manager asks how you see the last six months; you summarize results, one area to improve and next goals.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Speak in English for about 90 seconds: summarize two achievements with results, name one area for improvement, set a goal and ask for the support you need. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about 90 seconds: two achievements with results, one area for improvement with a plan, a goal for the next period and the support you need.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Thank you for making time for this review. Over the last six months, my main accomplishments were the new release process and the onboarding guide. The release process cut our release time by thirty percent, which means fewer late nights for the whole team. The onboarding guide helped three new engineers become productive in two weeks instead of five. One area for improvement is delegation. I tend to keep release tasks for myself, so I plan to share ownership with two teammates and review their work together. For the next period, my objective is to lead one design review every month and to mentor a junior engineer. The support I need is a clearer mentoring plan and some protected time for it. I would also like your feedback on whether these goals match the priorities of the team. Is there anything you would like me to adjust before we agree on them? I also want to thank you for the support you gave me during the last project.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Speak again in English. Keep the order and make your results more measurable.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Summarize a review for a different role, such as a tester or a data analyst.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Summarize a review for another period without looking at old notes.

rubric.label: Review order
rubric.description: The answer follows achievements, improvement, goals, support.

anchors.met: All four parts appear in order.
anchors.notMet: A part is missing, such as no support request.

rubric.label: Measured results
rubric.description: Achievements include numbers or clear changes.

anchors.met: Each achievement has a result a manager can check.

rubric.label: Professional tone
rubric.description: The tone is confident and open.

anchors.met: Names a weakness with a plan and invites feedback.

As a result, bugs found after release dropped by half.
I would like to get better at planning for the long term.
